Title: Walk the courtyard
Description: Walk the courtyard with residents at different times of day. Find where cars, play and quiet seating compete for space.

Title: Interview residents
Description: Speak with drivers, parents and older residents. Learn which needs overlap and which are hardest to reconcile.

Title: Study voting rules
Description: Review how homeowners' votes are called, counted and recorded. Learn what the software must check for a valid decision.

Title: Audit the last paper vote
Description: Reconstruct the last count from the tally sheets. Learn which parts of the decision residents can verify later.

Title: Test a paper ballot
Description: Hand out sample ballots for the parking, playground and quiet garden proposals. Learn where the wording leaves voters unsure.

Title: Mock up a ballot
Description: Build a clickable ballot and watch residents cast sample votes. Learn where people hesitate or misread a button.

Title: Prototype the quorum check
Description: Test eligibility and quorum rules with sample owner lists. Learn which cases need a manual review.

Title: Sketch the results chart
Description: Draw ways to show totals and turnout side by side. Learn whether residents can read the outcome without help.

Title: Hire a civic-tech developer
Description: Ask candidates to build a small vote-counting feature. Learn how they explain their design and test their work.

Title: Recruit resident volunteers
Description: Invite volunteers from several entrances to help run a practice vote. Find out where the team needs more support.

Title: Partner with a housing lawyer
Description: Ask a housing lawyer to review the pilot rules. Learn which disputes the rules need to cover before voting starts.

Title: Find a neutral moderator
Description: Have candidates lead a short meeting about parking and play space. Learn who can keep a heated discussion on the agenda.

Title: Build a web ballot
Description: Put a working ballot on the web and try it on older phones. Learn what it takes to submit a vote on a slow connection.

Title: Add Kazakh and Russian
Description: Translate the ballot and ask residents to read it in their preferred language. Learn which voting terms need clearer wording.

Title: Import paper ballots
Description: Add a way to enter signed paper ballots and check for duplicate entries. Learn which mistakes a second clerk can catch.

Title: Build a public audit log
Description: Record changes to the ballot rules and each step of the count. Learn which records residents can check without seeing personal details.

Title: Run a courtyard pilot
Description: Run a vote on courtyard renovation with one homeowners' association. Learn where residents and staff need help during a real count.

Title: Test with a second OSI
Description: Set up a trial for another homeowners' association with different rules. Learn what its committee needs to configure.

Title: Test with older residents
Description: Watch older residents use a sample ballot on the devices they have. Learn which steps need clearer instructions or larger controls.

Title: Open a results page
Description: Publish a trial tally with turnout, totals and the counting rules. Learn what residents still need to check the result.

Title: Build owner vote confirmation
Description: Test confirmation codes with owners who live on site and owners who rent out their flats. Learn where code delivery or recovery fails.

Title: Improve ballot accessibility
Description: Test keyboard controls, text size and screen-reader labels. Learn which barriers keep residents from voting on their own.

Title: Show proposal costs
Description: Put comparable cost estimates next to the renovation proposals. Learn how residents weigh a project's price and upkeep.

Title: Build an OSI admin panel
Description: Let a committee set up a vote and correct mistakes before it opens. Learn which settings need a review step.

Title: Choose an open licence
Description: Compare licences with associations and developers who might reuse the tool. Learn which terms protect openness and support adoption.

Title: Reduce stored voter data
Description: List what the service collects, who can access it and when it can be deleted. Learn which records the vote actually needs.

Title: Write the documentation
Description: Document the rules, the data format and the setup steps. Learn which assumptions trip up a new maintainer.

Title: Apply to the DPG Registry
Description: Collect evidence of open licensing, privacy safeguards and contributions to SDG 11. Find out which parts of the application need more work.

Title: Launch Courtyard Vote
Description: Release the software, voting rules and public documentation. Learn which questions new associations ask before they try it.

Title: Write an OSI setup guide
Description: Ask a committee member to install the software from a clean copy. Learn which steps the guide leaves unclear.

Title: Tell the pilot story
Description: Brief a local reporter on how residents checked the count. Learn which parts of the process the public finds hard to follow.

Title: Train association chairs
Description: Have chairs practise setting up a vote and responding to a challenge. Learn which tasks require more support.

Title: Maintain the software
Description: Review bug reports and test fixes against past ballots. Learn which problems most often interrupt an association's work.

Title: Convene a rules council
Description: Invite residents and association staff to review proposed rule changes. Learn where different sites need flexibility.

Title: Publish anonymised results
Description: Prepare vote totals and turnout data for civic researchers to reuse. Learn which useful breakdowns can be shared safely.

Title: Hand over to volunteers
Description: Let volunteer maintainers run a release and respond to support requests. Learn which duties need a clearer handover.
